mentions.name: Transcription-based video editing script
mentions.description: Transcription-based video editing script written as a couple hundred lines of Python wrapping Whisper and FFmpeg. A first pass produces a timestamped transcript and a plain text transcript for editing; after the words are edited into any order, a second pass reassembles the video. It also speeds up silences 4x within retained sequences and can burn in captions when silence removal makes the audio choppy.
mentions.problem: A co-worker had difficulty editing a work demo, where editing out silences had previously required manual work.
mentions.source_excerpt: So a couple of hours later I'd written a script that does transcription based editing: on the first pass it grabs a timestamped transcript and a plain text transcript for editing; you edit the words into any order you like and a second pass reassembles the video (it's just a couple of hundred lines of python wrapping whisper and ffmpeg).
